decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from tobymao/sqlglot PR #8229 (human-authored; the suite skips this repo's AI-tagged PRs), merged 2026-08-20, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Multi-table ANALYZE failed to parse in every dialect and multi-table DROP failed for non-TABLE kinds; DROP TABLE a, b parsed but split the targets across a scalar 'this' slot and a 'tables' list. The breaking fix (6 source files, system complexity) removes 'this' from the Drop and Analyze expressions, models targets as a uniform 'tables' list, and threads the change through sqlglot/parser.py, generator.py, expressions/ddl.py, expressions/query.py, generators/tsql.py and parsers/spark2.py. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (4f73baae) to the sqlglot package plus LICENSE (same slicing as the v4 sqlglot tasks); dependency-free, runs on the base sandbox image with PYTHONPATH=. Coverage: 6 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — mysql multi-table and LOCAL qualified ANALYZE, postgres plain and VERBOSE, generic DROP VIEW a, b, tsql catalog-stripping across the listed tables, and an AST-shape test asserting all DROP targets land in the tables list; 4 pass_to_pass guards pin the already-working multi-table DROP TABLE round trips, single-table DROP/ANALYZE forms, and a plain SELECT. Assertions compare transpile output strings and AST table lists, never error text.
